text: Good morning, / Lakeview Community Center. //
speaker: Linda

text: Linda speaking. / How can I help you? //
speaker: Linda

text: Hi. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I'm calling about the weekend activities / for young professionals. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I saw your poster / at the coffee shop / near my office. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Great. //
speaker: Linda

text: Are you thinking of joining? //
speaker: Linda

text: Yes. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I graduated in June, / and I've just started my first job, / so I don't have much free time anymore. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I'd like to find something fun / to do on the weekend. //
speaker: Ryan

text: No problem. //
speaker: Linda

text: Let me take a few details. //
speaker: Linda

text: What's your name? //
speaker: Linda

text: It's Ryan Bryant. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Can you spell your last name for me? //
speaker: Linda

text: Sure. //
speaker: Ryan

text: It's B-R-Y-A-N-T. //
speaker: Ryan

text: B-R-Y-A-N-T. //
speaker: Linda

text: Thanks. //
speaker: Linda

text: And what do you do, Ryan? //
speaker: Linda

text: I did an internship in marketing last year, / but now I'm a junior accountant / at a small company downtown. //
speaker: Ryan

text: And what's your address? //
speaker: Linda

text: It's twenty-four... sorry, no, / forty-two Maple Street. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I only moved into a small apartment there / last month. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I share the kitchen and the living room / with two roommates. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Forty-two Maple Street. //
speaker: Linda

text: That's just a ten-minute walk from here. //
speaker: Linda

text: And can I have a phone number? //
speaker: Linda

text: Sure. //
speaker: Ryan

text: It's five-five-five, / oh-one-six-four. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Five-five-five, / oh-one-four-six. //
speaker: Linda

text: No, sorry. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Oh-one-six-four. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Got it. //
speaker: Linda

text: So, which days are you usually free? //
speaker: Linda

text: Well, / I have a hectic schedule at the moment. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I'm snowed under with work / from Monday to Friday. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I usually get up at six / and I never get home before seven. //
speaker: Ryan

text: And on Saturdays, / I do the laundry and do the shopping, / so Sunday is really my only day off. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I see. //
speaker: Linda

text: And can I ask / why you'd like to join? //
speaker: Linda

text: To be honest, / I used to sleep in / and binge-watch TV series all weekend, / but it didn't really help. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I just need something / to help me unwind / after a long week. //
speaker: Ryan

text: That's what most of our members say. //
speaker: Linda

text: So, / we have a few activities on Sundays / that might suit you. //
speaker: Linda

text: The first one is Social Badminton. //
speaker: Linda

text: Oh, / I played badminton a lot in college, / but I'm not very good at it. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I never win! //
speaker: Ryan

text: What time does it start? //
speaker: Ryan

text: It used to start at nine o'clock, / but lots of people wanted to sleep in, / so now it starts at half past nine / and finishes at a quarter to twelve. //
speaker: Linda

text: And don't worry, / we play for fun. //
speaker: Linda

text: Nobody keeps score, / and you don't have to beat anyone. //
speaker: Linda

text: That's good to hear. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Do I need to bring anything? //
speaker: Ryan

text: We provide the shuttlecocks, / but you need to bring your own racket. //
speaker: Linda

text: That's fine. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I still have one somewhere. //
speaker: Ryan

text: The second activity is our Picnic and Kite Day. //
speaker: Linda

text: It's on the last Sunday of every month. //
speaker: Linda

text: People just hang out, / have a picnic, / play volleyball / and fly kites. //
speaker: Linda

text: Where do you meet? //
speaker: Ryan

text: It's in Riverside Park. //
speaker: Linda

text: Not at the main entrance, though, / because the parking lot there is always full. //
speaker: Linda

text: We usually meet next to the lake. //
speaker: Linda

text: And how much does it cost? //
speaker: Ryan

text: Members pay a monthly fee / that covers everything. //
speaker: Linda

text: For the general public, / it's forty-five dollars a month, / but young professionals under twenty-five / only pay thirty-five. //
speaker: Linda

text: Great. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I'm twenty-three. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Then you can have the lower price. //
speaker: Linda

text: For the picnic, / we bring a basket of sandwiches / and some bottles of water, / but please bring a blanket to sit on. //
speaker: Linda

text: OK. //
speaker: Ryan

text: And is there anything else? //
speaker: Ryan

text: There's also a walking group. //
speaker: Linda

text: They go hiking in the hills / every Sunday afternoon. //
speaker: Linda

text: It's hard work, / but it's really fun. //
speaker: Linda

text: That sounds nice. //
speaker: Ryan

text: I think I'll try badminton first / and squeeze in the picnic / at the end of the month. //
speaker: Ryan

text: Perfect. //
speaker: Linda

text: It's a great way / to recharge your batteries. //
speaker: Linda
